title: Attachments
pendingHint: Files will be uploaded when you save the transaction.
unsupported: Unsupported file type. Allowed: images or PDF

scan.title: Scan document
scan.description: Straighten and clean up a photo of a document before attaching it.
scan.analysing: Looking for a document in the photo…
scan.failed: The document could not be scanned. You can still attach the photo as it is.

styleHints.colour: Evens out the lighting, lifts the contrast and sharpens the text.
styleHints.grayscale: The same clean-up without the colour. Smaller, and free of the tint paper picks up under artificial light.
styleHints.blackAndWhite: Ink and paper only. Best for printed text; it will flatten photos and logos.
styleHints.none: Straightened and cropped, otherwise exactly as photographed. Use this when the clean-up spoils the subject.

scan.adjustHint: Switch to Original to drag the corners if the edges are wrong.
scan.noDocumentFound: No document edges were found, so the whole photo was used. Switch to Original and drag the corners to set them yourself.
scan.originalTooLarge: The original photo is larger than {max}, so only the enhanced scan will be attached.

warnings.blurry: The photo looks blurred. Retaking it will give a sharper scan.
warnings.edgesOutsideFrame: The document reaches the edge of the photo, so a side may be cut off. Retake it with a margin around the whole page, with no side touching the border.
warnings.lowResolution: The scan is quite small, so fine print may be hard to read.

preview.failed: The preview could not be loaded. You can still download the file.
preview.storeUnavailable: This file is stored in a storage backend this server cannot currently reach, so it cannot be previewed or downloaded. Nothing is lost: ask your administrator to restore the attachment storage settings.
preview.unsupported: This file type cannot be previewed. You can still download it.
